propositions: BindingStore.unbind() conditionally removes reverse entries only when the forward entry contains a jira_key, leaking orphaned reverse keys when forward entries lack jira_key or are deleted out-of-band
Orphaned reverse bindings cannot be cleaned up through the public API, causing bridge fsck to report permanent store_integrity violations that mask genuine faults
Concurrent merge conflicts on bindings.json with merge=ours strategy can drop forward entries wholesale without removing corresponding reverse entries, producing persistent drift
The unbind() method must unconditionally remove both forward and reverse index entries, using a fast O(1) keyed pop followed by a sweep for any residual reverse keys pointing to the local_id

A new rebar bridge fsck --repair verb is needed to prune verified orphaned reverse bindings through the existing BindingStore.unbind() API, guarded against corruption and mutation of forward entries or retired keys
